decisions_required_before_native_impleme.subject: Number range and settlement representation
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.why: Reference floats cannot safely store arbitrary-range wallets or grant integer entitlement at all boundaries.
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.deliverable: Choose smallest accounted unit, production number range, remainder carry, comparison and exact integer Chart verification. Prototype representative late-game magnitudes and overflow handling.
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.accountable: GE with platform/state and QA review

decisions_required_before_native_impleme.subject: Price rounding and bulk/max-buy equivalence
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.why: The blueprint gives mathematical real prices; rounding every purchase versus a bulk sum can change affordability.
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.deliverable: Specify one settlement rule for single/bulk/max purchases, prove no rounding arbitrage, and define near-zero absolute precision without allowing a tolerance to buy unaffordable units.
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.accountable: GE with economy/design and QA review

decisions_required_before_native_impleme.subject: Stable ordering at identical timestamps
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.why: The roadmap defines earnings before boundary events and commands afterward, but simultaneous automatic purchases/resets, rollover, bonus expiry and receipt effects require a complete ordering.
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.deliverable: Specify total ordering and stable event/command identifiers; add reset-plus-expiry, survey-plus-rollover, purchase-plus-milestone and crash/retry fixtures.
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.accountable: GE with platform/claims and QA review

decisions_required_before_native_impleme.subject: Fractional timer phase at capacity
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.why: Focus retains fractional progress, Surveys stop when the completed queue is full, and neither may bank hidden overflow beyond capacity.
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.deliverable: Define saved phase, when charging resumes after collection, and whether exact-boundary collection precedes the next cycle; demonstrate daily-collection parity without overgeneration.
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.accountable: GE with economy/design and QA review

decisions_required_before_native_impleme.subject: Automation policy contract and deterministic tie breaking
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.why: The reference instant greedy policy is a bounded experiment; player plans need explicit affordability, waiting, disabled-tier, priority and reset semantics.
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.deliverable: Define allowed plans, tie-break order, behavior at unlocks, batch mode and reset horizon/threshold meaning. Preserve the same decisions online/offline and explain forecast assumptions.
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.accountable: GE with client and economy/design review

decisions_required_before_native_impleme.subject: Replay and economic version transitions
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.why: A return interval must use the saved version before adopting a downloaded rebalance.
decisions_required_before_native_impleme.deliverable: Pin configuration/policy versions, carry settlement timestamps and pending transitions, and coordinate atomic commit/retry with persistence so repeated resume does not double-pay.

cross_team_dependencies: Client: native host, command dispatch, forecast presentation and accessible activity controls.
Platform: atomic persistence, configuration versions, account-day identity, claims, Note and XP ledgers.
Content/art: six chapter goals, twelve challenges/calibrations, first-season manifest and reward IDs.
QA/release: independent conformance checks, fault injection, device profiling and real calendar observation.
